description: Q07 — addresses of German customers who have invoices. 2-table join, WHERE on a non-key column (Customer.Country). NOTE: Chinook ships its own FK indexes, so the IFK_* statements here recreate Chinook's originals by name — the notebook drops them first to get a genuinely unindexed baseline.
normalized_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.Address FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'
denormalized_sql: SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAddress FROM SalesFlat WHERE CustomerCountry = 'Germany'

description: Q20 — average unit price of Jazz tracks. 2-table join, aggregation, WHERE on a non-key column (Genre.Name). NOTE: Chinook ships its own FK indexes, so the IFK_* statements here recreate Chinook's originals by name — the notebook drops them first to get a genuinely unindexed baseline.
normalized_sql: SELECT AVG(t.UnitPrice) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'
denormalized_sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM TrackFlat WHERE GenreName = 'Jazz'

description: Q14 — artist with the most albums. 2-table join plus GROUP BY and ORDER BY on an aggregate. NOTE: Chinook ships its own FK indexes, so the IFK_* statements here recreate Chinook's originals by name — the notebook drops them first to get a genuinely unindexed baseline.
normalized_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
denormalized_sql: SELECT ArtistName FROM (SELECT DISTINCT AlbumId, ArtistName FROM TrackFlat) GROUP BY ArtistName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
denormalized_indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_trackflat_artist_album ON TrackFlat(ArtistName, AlbumId)

description: Q10 — count tracks of a given media type. Join against the largest table (3,503 tracks), WHERE on a non-key name column. NOTE: Chinook ships its own FK indexes, so the IFK_* statements here recreate Chinook's originals by name — the notebook drops them first to get a genuinely unindexed baseline.
normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE m.Name = 'AAC audio file'
denormalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TrackFlat WHERE MediaTypeName = 'AAC audio file'

description: Q11 — support representative for customer Leonie. Join plus WHERE on a non-key customer first name.
normalized_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE c.FirstName = 'Leonie'
denormalized_sql: SELECT RepFirstName, RepLastName FROM CustomerFlat WHERE CustomerFirstName = 'Leonie'

description: Q15 — albums containing tracks priced above 1. Join, WHERE predicate, and GROUP BY.
normalized_sql: SELECT a.Title, t.AlbumId FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE t.UnitPrice > 1 GROUP BY t.AlbumId, a.Title
denormalized_sql: SELECT AlbumTitle, AlbumId FROM TrackFlat WHERE UnitPrice > 1 GROUP BY AlbumId, AlbumTitle

description: Q19 — count customers whose email contains gmail.com. WHERE on a non-key text column.
normalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Email LIKE '%gmail.com%'
denormalized_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CustomerFlat WHERE Email LIKE '%gmail.com%'
